_encabezado: AI-assisted (Claude Code) — ROOT, NASA Space Apps 2026; initial version with OpenAI Codex
_nota: Referencias curadas del tablero (web/dashboard.html). motor/dashboard_web.py las publica en web/data/dashboard.json y agrega la superficie regada de cada año de historia_anios, leída del CSV de Conagua (historia_archivo, columna historia_columna): aquí no se teclea ninguna superficie. Textos en inglés (regla 9); las llaves no cambian porque web/js/dashboard.js las lee.
etiqueta: [P] team research notes (press compilation); not checked against primary sources
fuente: Team research notes received on Nov 14, 2026: «Cultivos y riego en el DR-005» (Crops and irrigation in DR-005), «Investigación OpenET y FARMS» (OpenET and FARMS research) and «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region). They are internal notes and are not published with the page; they are used as references, not as instructions.

fuentes.titulo: Conagua: irrigated area and volumes in DR-005, 1998–2025
fuentes.descripcion: Total irrigated area per agricultural year. The history chart reads it from the copy kept in this repository: data/raw/conagua/dr005_superficies_volumenes_1998_2025.csv, column sup_total_ha.

fuentes.titulo: NASA POWER: daily rainfall and reference evapotranspiration
fuentes.descripcion: Regional grid cell, not a weather station or a rain gauge in the field. The historical rainfall range and its back-test are computed from this series.
Water demand per crop comes from the project's demand model (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56). The dashboard reads the same figures as the field sheet of the main page.
Press compilation behind the timeline. Each event names where it comes from; none has been checked against a primary source yet.

historia_fuente: Conagua, irrigated areas and volumes of Irrigation District 005 Delicias, 1998–2025: total irrigated area per agricultural year (data/raw/conagua/dr005_superficies_volumenes_1998_2025.csv, column sup_total_ha). Selected years; the file has every year.

eventos.detalle: The note lists it among the most widespread and severe droughts on record. It gives no local figures by crop.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 1; attributed to SMN, without a primary link.

eventos.detalle: A levee broke and watermelon, chile, cotton, maize and alfalfa were damaged, according to the note.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; press compilation, check pending.

eventos.detalle: Drought limited the agricultural cycle. Dam storage also decides whether planting is possible, even with local rain.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; press compilation, check pending.

eventos.detalle: The note reports flooded farmland across the state. It is not a measurement of the pilot areas.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; municipalities cited: Camargo, La Cruz, Saucillo and San Francisco de Conchos.

eventos.detalle: According to the note, the storage recovered in the previous season allowed a full cycle.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; it refers to dam storage in September 2022.

eventos.detalle: The note links low dam storage with a sharp drop in plantings and damage to alfalfa.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; press compilation, check pending.

eventos.titulo: Reduced season and pressure on perennial crops
eventos.detalle: The note describes risk for alfalfa and job losses. This is regional context, not an observation per field.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), p. 2; press compilation, check pending.

eventos.titulo: Late rain during the peanut harvest
eventos.detalle: The note reports damage to peanuts already pulled from the ground and a drop in their price. Price belongs in any study of how climate relates to planted area.
eventos.fuente: Team note «Clima y siembras en la región de Delicias» (Climate and plantings in the Delicias region), pp. 2–3; report included in the note of Nov 14, 2026, not independently verified.
